snippet.title: Never lick sweets from strangers!
snippet.description:
Welcome to Will You Be My Disciple?, a narrative cult-management game. As you manage resources and make critical choices, you'll encounter bizarre situations.

Developed by Narradive Studios, a 5-person indie team, we are bringing this dark, humorous adventure to life right from our homes.

If you want to see what happens after the lollipop incident, support us by adding the game to your wishlist! 👇

- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140510
- Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/will-you-be-my-disciple-0512c5

Join our cult (Community):

- Discord: https://discord.gg/pH6bXunESQ
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/studionarradive
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/narradivestudios.bsky.social
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/narradivestudios/
- Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@narradivestudios
